Musical Key: A-flat Major

This is hymn number 150 titled "O Thou Kind and Gracious Father" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Edwin F. Parry and the lyrics were written by Charles Denney Jr..
